text:
Maria (CS): quick heads up — Orchard Labs renewal bumped into a procurement gate. They need a manual invoice (CC->PO) + a shortened 9mo term, and onboarding enablement can't start until payment cleared :grimacing:
Sam (AE): ugh. do they have a PO number yet? we need the PO to route to finance
Maria (CS): not yet. procurement asked for a draft invoice to attach to the PO request. asked them for vendor code and approver name. also asked if they can sign in DocuSign or need a wet signature
Kevin (PM): hold onboarding until legal okays the 9mo term change — we have an enablement kickoff slot next Tue, if we miss it the CS ramp slips a month
Ana (Legal): cc @Maria (CS) — send me the proposed amendment text. for a 9mo term we need to check clause 4.2 and auto-renew language. can we keep pricing pro-rated instead of discounting?
Maria (CS): sending amendment draft and invoice stub here — attaching link: https://docs.redwood/example/orchard-amend-1918 (customer-facing)
Maria (CS): invoice-bot, please generate manual invoice stub for Orchard Labs so I can attach to their procurement ticket
invoice-bot: created manual invoice stub INV-2026-0873 for Orchard Labs. PDF: https://invoices.redwood/inv/INV-2026-0873
Sam (AE): great — can you add payment terms Net30 and billing entity = "Orchard Labs US, Inc" on the stub? procurement insisted on entity matching their AP system
invoice-bot: updated INV-2026-0873: payment_terms=Net30, billing_entity="Orchard Labs US, Inc"
Maria (CS): @Ana (Legal) putting the amendment in a comment below. small redline: remove auto-renew; customer wants to re-evaluate at renewal. also note we'll grant one onboarding session and record enablement materials
Ana (Legal): ok I can sign off on these redlines assuming finance approves Net30. I'll queue for a quick review, should be under 24h
Sam (AE): procurement asked whether we can accept split billing across two subsidiaries (they have EU and US entities). finance@redwood, any blockers?
Kevin (PM): if split billing is needed, we should decouple onboarding deliverables per entity. that adds coordination but doable
Maria (CS): replied to procurement: "we can accept PO for Orchard Labs US and issue separate invoices for EU entity, but onboarding seat allocation must be consolidated under US entity for now." they replied: "we'll confirm vendor codes by EOD"
Maria (CS): next steps: 1) attach INV-2026-0873 to their PO request 2) Ana to approve amendment 3) Sam to confirm pricing lines for 9mo pro-rate 4) Kevin to tentatively hold next Tue slot until payment clears
Sam (AE): I'll update the quote and push to the customer with a clear line-item: "9-month pro-rated subscription" and seat count. ETA 2 hours
Ana (Legal): reviewing amendment now — will post signed version here when complete :+1:
Maria (CS): thanks. tagging @invoice-bot once more to mark when finance marks invoice paid so we can unlock onboarding
invoice-bot: payment status for INV-2026-0873 is PENDING (no payment event yet)
Sam (AE): noted. I'll follow up with procurement contact on the PO/approver and expedite the vendor code
Maria (CS): (updated) procurement sent vendor code VA-ORCH-221. they also asked for a 'statement of work' PDF rather than a link. uploading SOW now: https://files.redwood/sow/orchard-sow-1918.pdf
Kevin (PM): once invoice shows PAID, confirm final kickoff invite and I'll send onboarding checklist. if payment slips >72h we shift to asynchronous onboarding
Maria (CS): will monitor. closing loop here but will post final status. :wave:
